einzeiler: Revisiting the 1986 murder case of Scott Macklem with reporter Josie Duffy Rice.
kurzfassung: Reporter Josie Duffy Rice re-examines the 1986 daylight murder of Scott Macklem and the subsequent arrest made eight days later. Nearly forty years later, the investigation questions whether the wrong man has been imprisoned the entire time. The season explores the details of this historical criminal case.
stichpunkte: The 1986 murder of Scott Macklem in broad daylight
An arrest made eight days following the crime
A modern re-examination of the case by reporter Josie Duffy Rice
Questions surrounding the validity of the original conviction nearly 40 years later
beschreibung:
In 1986, a man named Scott Macklem was killed in broad daylight. Eight days later, a suspect was arrested. But now, almost 40 years later, reporter Josie Duffy Rice is re-examining this case. Has the wrong man been in prison this whole time?
